en.t: I, too, refused to admit defeat and talked back.

units.source_text: 起初还跟刚才一样，你一言我一语的争吵，

en.t: At first, it was just like before, with each of us answering the other back in an argument,

units.source_text: 没想到后来哥哥竟然抓着我脖子后面的头发

en.t: but then, to my surprise, my older brother grabbed the hair at the back of my neck

units.source_text: 把我打倒在地，继续骂道：“野丫头！”

en.t: knocked me down to the ground, and went on scolding me: "You wild girl!"
